🎬 The Good Wife (2009–2016) — Drama, Legal
Alicia Florrick's life changes completely when her husband, a prominent state's attorney, becomes involved in a public scandal and is sent to prison. Forced to rebuild her life and support her family, Alicia returns to the legal profession after years away and begins working at a Chicago law firm.
As Alicia rebuilds her career, she faces demanding cases, difficult opponents, and the challenge of proving herself in a competitive legal world. At the same time, her personal life becomes increasingly complicated as she deals with her husband's actions, her own ambitions, and the expectations placed on her by family and society.
The series explores loyalty, betrayal, ambition, marriage, justice, independence, and personal growth. Alicia's journey shows how someone can be forced into a new beginning and gradually discover that the person they become may be very different from the person they once were.
More than just a legal drama, The Good Wife is a story about rebuilding your identity after everything you thought you knew about your life changes. ❤️‍🩹
💬 If your life suddenly fell apart because of someone else's choices, would you start over or try to save what you had? 👇

source_details.synopsis: The Good Wife is an American legal political drama television series that aired on CBS from September 22, 2009, to May 8, 2016. It focuses on Alicia Florrick, the wife of the Cook County State's Attorney, who returns to her career in law after the events of a public sex and political corruption scandal involving her husband. The Good Wife is a serialized show with standalone storylines that are concluded by the end of each episode. It also features several story arcs that play out over multiple episodes or seasons.
